specs = [{'"'"'id'"'"': '"'"'fresh_full_E1'"'"', '"'"'kind'"'"': '"'"'fresh_full_cohort'"'"', '"'"'argv'"'"': ['"'"'physim'"'"', '"'"'--env.taskset.difficulty'"'"', '"'"'BLOB2v2r2-E1'"'"', '"'"'BLOB2v2r2-E1'"'"', '"'"'-m'"'"', '"'"'anthropic/claude-fable-5'"'"', '"'"'-n'"'"', '"'"'1'"'"', '"'"'-r'"'"', '"'"'1'"'"', '"'"'-c'"'"', '"'"'1'"'"', '"'"'--shuffle'"'"', '"'"'False'"'"', '"'"'--env.taskset.tier'"'"', '"'"'tools'"'"', '"'"'--env.taskset.seed0'"'"', '"'"'0'"'"', '"'"'--env.scientist.harness.id'"'"', '"'"'claude_code'"'"', '"'"'--env.scientist.harness.version'"'"', '"'"'False'"'"', '"'"'--env.scientist.max-turns'"'"', '"'"'8'"'"', '"'"'--env.scientist.timeout.rollout'"'"', '"'"'180'"'"']}]
results = []
for spec in specs:
    argv = with_positional_taskset(spec["argv"])
    sys.argv = ["native-parse-only", *argv]
    c = cli(narrow_config(EvalConfig, argv))
    scientist = c.env.scientist
    row = {"id": spec["id"], "kind": spec["kind"],
           "env_type": type(c.env).__name__, "difficulty": c.env.taskset.difficulty,
           "seed0": c.env.taskset.seed0, "shuffle": c.shuffle,
           "model": c.model, "tasks": c.num_tasks, "rollouts": c.num_rollouts,
           "concurrency": c.max_concurrent, "tier": c.env.taskset.tier,
           "harness": scientist.harness.model_dump(mode="json"),
           "runtime": scientist.runtime.type,
           "model_turn_cap": scientist.max_turns,
           "token_caps": {k:getattr(scientist,k) for k in
                          ("max_input_tokens","max_output_tokens","max_total_tokens")},
           "agent_timeouts": scientist.timeout.model_dump(mode="json"),
           "env_timeouts": c.env.timeout.model_dump(mode="json"),
           "env_retries": c.env.retries.model_dump(mode="json"),
           "agent_retries": scientist.retries.model_dump(mode="json"),
           "rich": c.rich, "server": c.server, "resume": c.resume,
           "push": c.push, "explicit_output_dir": c.output_dir}
    assert type(c.env).__name__ == "PhysimEnvConfig"
    assert c.model == "anthropic/claude-fable-5"
    assert c.env.taskset.seed0 == 0 and c.shuffle is False
    assert c.num_rollouts == 1 and c.max_concurrent == 1
    assert c.server is False and c.resume is None
    assert c.env.retries.max_retries == scientist.retries.max_retries == 0
    assert "ResourceSafetyError" in c.env.retries.exclude
    assert "ResourceSafetyError" in scientist.retries.exclude
    assert c.push is False
    if spec["kind"] == "fresh_full_cohort":
        assert c.num_tasks == 3
        assert scientist.max_turns is None
        assert all(v is None for v in row["token_caps"].values())
        assert scientist.timeout.rollout is None
        assert c.env.timeout.episode is None
    else:
        assert c.num_tasks == 1 and scientist.max_turns == 8
        assert scientist.timeout.rollout == 180
    results.append(row)
print(json.dumps({"parse_only":True, "actual_eval_launches":0, "results":results}, indent=2))
'

publication.recommendation: Keep --push False until root approves publication; root may change it to --push True.
publication.credentials: Use normal configured environment/CLI credentials. No credentials are embedded here.

notes: These are proposed commands, not launched evaluations.
Full E1/E2 commands use n=3, r=1, c=1, shuffle=False, seed0=0.
Full commands have no model-turn, total-token, or solve wall-time cap.
No --resume or --server path is selected; output uses a fresh native UUID directory.
Run full E1/E2 commands sequentially if total host rollout concurrency must remain one.
New r2 cohort validation forces both whole-run retry counts to zero and keeps ResourceSafetyError exclusions.
Transient per-call SDK retries remain unchanged.
The optional Fable5 smoke is one E1 task with eight model turns and a 180-second solve bound; it is not a science-score cohort.
